selection_limit: Named today, not a historically selected survivor-free universe; do not claim universe-selection alpha.

final_holdout.limit: Prospective interval, not a promise of adequate power or a capital deployment date. Candidate must be frozen before its first eligible observation; later candidates require a new future holdout.

timing: Signals use only observations available before next-session order submission; distributions are receivables on ex-date and spendable only on payment date. No same-close fills.
promotion: No automatic promotion. Data review, execution engine, locked candidate, family trial ledger, independent OOS economics and forward execution must all pass separately.
